main_text.p: in ufu ipfo linguæ, & ex ufu practico, pluribus exemplis ad unum præceptum Grammaticum revocatis, & eadem doctrina sæpius repetita, longè firmius memoriæ imprimet, & longè dilucidius explicabit, quam si in nuda præceptorum theoria primum quis infistat.

page.notes: The Hebrew is reproduced from the scan as consonants with the transliteration printed beneath it. The Hebrew tokens are copied from the scan with the printer's spellings; "leefoph" and "lifchpoch" are the printed transliterations, not corrected.
